name: PostgreSQL
shortInfo: Sync data from your data warehouse to PostgreSQL
about:
PostgreSQL is a powerful, open source object-relational database system with over 35 years of active development that has earned it a strong reputation for reliability, feature robustness, and performance.  
  
Learn more about [PosgreSQL.](https://www.postgresql.org/)
availableSync:
[Export](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/postgre-sql/syncs/export.html)

This sync can be used to request and retrieve data from a user specified datawarehouse to the PostgreSQL.

Learn more about what data can be integrated into your data warehouse using DataChannel in the [documentation](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/postgre-sql/index.html) here.
